name: Pigeonhole Constraint Framing
description: Replaces the explicit algebraic zero-energy condition with a 2-coloring constraint on 3 vertices. Since 3 vertices must be assigned to 2 colors, by the Pigeonhole Principle at least two must share a color. The only way this always forces an edge conflict is if all three vertices are mutually connected (a triangle). Models that take the text literally will write an O(n^3) search and TLE, while models that reason logically will realize it's just finding a triangle and use the fast O(n*m/64) bitset approach.
